source.read: S3 opal-data-harvest derived/model_block/<key>/<stamp>/model_block.json, the newest stamp per key, read-only
source.twin_keys_note: S3 also holds BP-SLASH-_LN_Equity and NG-SLASH-_LN_Equity (the -SLASH- twins of the excluded slash keys BP/_LN_Equity and NG/_LN_Equity); they are NOT in this census (Z-S64 exclusion of BP and NG applied to both key forms)

method.market_cap_read: CUR_MKT_CAP / (PX_LAST x EQY_SH_OUT_REAL), all three from the same block; for a GBp quote PX_LAST is divided by 100 (pence to pounds, a definitional subunit, not FX). A ratio of 1 within 0.2% decides the value is in the quote currency's major unit; anything else is UNRESOLVED (never an FX-scaled guess).
method.identity_read: CURR_ENTP_VAL ~ CUR_MKT_CAP/1e6 + NET_DEBT under four EV-side/ND-side hypotheses (QQ, RR, RQ, QR), tolerance +/-12%; the market cap is converted to the reporting currency only with a factor f implied by the block's own Bloomberg dimensionless ratios (PX_TO_BOOK_RATIO x BOOK_VAL_PER_SH / PX_LAST agreeing within 3% with PE_RATIO x IS_EPS / PX_LAST at the latest FY carrying all four). No external FX rate is used and none is invented.
method.side_rule: A side (quote or reporting) is decided for a figure only if the best hypothesis residual with it is within 12% and the best residual with the other side is beyond 24%.
method.no_factor_rule: With no block-implied factor, the all-quote identity holding does NOT decide (a same-magnitude reporting currency is not excluded); the identity failing plus the EV tracking read (header EV / (CURRENT_EV_TO_T12M_EBITDA x EBITDA) over the price ratio, within 12%) decides EV only.
method.gbp_note: For quote GBp: a value measured in GBP (the major unit) has no label in the two-class vocabulary: it is 'reporting' only where the reporting currency is GBP; otherwise UNRESOLVED.
